messages.author: fd4f3538f907404b
messages.subject: issue with scale_x_continuous(trans=logit_trans())
parts:
I could swear this used to work ... can anyone see the problem with
this? I am trying to use scale_x_continuous(trans=logit_trans()) to set
a logit scale on the x axis ...

set.seed(101)
ss1 <- data.frame(SAR=c(0.2,0.5,0.7),Year=1:3)
ss0 <- data.frame(SAR=runif(100),Year=1:100)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

g1 <- ggplot(ss1,
aes(x=SAR,y=Year))+
geom_point() +
scale_x_continuous(trans=logit_trans())
g1 ## works
g1 %+% ss0
## Error in seq.default(dots[[1L]][[1L]], dots[[2L]][[1L]], length =
dots[[3L]][[1L]]) :
## 'from' cannot be NA, NaN or infinite

sessionInfo()

messages.subject: Re: issue with scale_x_continuous(trans=logit_trans())
parts:
Ben, 

Looks like it's trying include 0 in the x-axis when setting the scales. 

ss2 <- data.frame(SAR=c(0.01,0.2,0.5,0.7),Year=1:4)

ggplot(ss1,
       aes(x=SAR,y=Year))+
    geom_point() +
    scale_x_continuous(trans=logit_trans())
Error in seq.default(dots[[1L]][[1L]], dots[[2L]][[1L]], length = dots[[3L]][[1L]]) :
'from' cannot be NA, NaN or infinite

Perhaps some error correcting code was removed? 

Brandon
